info.title: Converis CUD API
info.description:
This documentation is for viewing purposes only. Therefore, no actual result is displayed even though you can click on “Try it out” button. Generating the actual URL from this documentation is not possible because it depends on the host and port, which are different for customers.
              

The CUD API facilitates Create, Update, and Delete operations on data entities within the converis, enabling clients to add, modify, and remove records programmatically.

## Access and Credentials 
The URL of API has the following pattern ___https://{host}:{port}/converis/ws/___ where *{host}* is the IP or the Hostname of your Converis installation. *{port}* must be provided only if it differs from 443.

___Eg___: ___https://your_converis_system_url/converis/ws/v2/dataobjects/dataentities___  . Here port is not used as per request.

To use these endpoints (except Version API), an API authentication token needs to be issued by the Converis administrator from the configuration screen (Configuration --> API Authentication Info). 

The table below specifies which type of endpoints require which ___type of service___ permission for the  Converis API authentication.

| Type of endpoint | Type of service permission |
| ---------------- | -------------------------- |
| CUD - Dataentity / Linkentity             | CONVERIS_DATA_SERVICE     

The generated API authentication token must then be provided per basic authentication with each request to the API (username = app name and password = generated token). 

The URL needs to be adapted to the Converis instance’s specific domain.

## Limits and Security 
- All requests are secured through https (secure, TLS 1.2).


## Note
